# Gheware DevOps AI

> Gheware Technologies (Bengaluru, India) runs hands-on corporate training in Agentic AI, Kubernetes and DevOps, and Cloud Labs: a ready-to-use browser sandbox for every participant in a course. Founder and lead trainer Rajesh Gheware has 25+ years at JPMorgan Chase, Deutsche Bank and Morgan Stanley, holds CKA and CKS, and has trained 5,000+ professionals.

This file lists the pages on devops.gheware.com that best answer questions about our services. Each link goes to the canonical HTML page. For enquiries, use the form on the relevant page or email rajesh@gheware.com.

## Services

- [Cloud Labs](https://devops.gheware.com/training/cloud-labs.html): browser sandboxes for corporate training — Kubernetes, Linux, Docker GameDay, Python and AI/ML on GPU, Agentic AI (JupyterLab with LangChain, LangGraph, MCP) and Claude Code (VS Code). One URL and login per participant, no installs or VPN, ready within 24 hours, monitored during the session, deleted after. Supports 100+ participants; priced per cohort.
- [Corporate training](https://devops.gheware.com/training/corporate-training.html): instructor-led workshops for enterprise teams on Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD and Agentic AI.
- [Training hub](https://devops.gheware.com/training/): overview of courses, labs and certification preparation (CKA, CKAD, CKS).
- [TokenOps](https://devops.gheware.com/tokenops/): FinOps for LLM tokens — a gateway with one key per person and daily caps, capped Claude sandboxes, a masterclass and a token audit.

## Resources

- [Blog](https://devops.gheware.com/blog/): articles on Kubernetes, platform engineering, DevOps and production AI agents.
- [LangGraph cheat sheet](https://devops.gheware.com/cheatsheet/): free two-page reference for teams building production AI agents.
- [AgentGrow browser assistant](https://devops.gheware.com/agentgrow/): free, open-source Chrome extension that automates browser tasks with any LLM provider.
